item.title: Wolverine 6.30: Optimized at least once delivery with “Native Acks”
item.description: Wolverine 6.30 is out. It is a big release with one clear headline: a new endpoint mode, EndpointMode.NativeAck, plus the supporting cast it needed to be trustworthy — lease renewal, an additional idempotency guard, partitioning, and a five-node chaos harness to address a reported issue.
